title: Canonical continuous coefficient charts commute with scheme direct image
statement: For a topological ring O and a scheme morphism f:Y→X, the canonical coefficient pushforward followed by the direct image of the continuous chart over Y equals the chart over X followed by sectionwise continuous-function pushforward. The latter map precomposes sections with the first scheme-pullback projection.

source.place: Section 6.8, Definition 6.8.10 and Proposition 6.8.11(1): integral coefficient framework and kernel-closure application; the displayed continuous-function pivot argument is an agent reduction, not a matrix argument written out in Lemma 6.8.7

proof.text: Apply the composite point and scheme adjunction Hom equivalence. The private, proved chartMate_homEquiv helper applies unit_comp_lowerStar_map_unit_comp_upperStarComp' and naturality of lowerStarComp to identify the adjunct of the coefficient mate followed by the pushed chart with the adjunct chart over Y followed by lowerStarFactor.inv. The defining equations of chartComparison identify both chart adjuncts.

Evaluate the resulting equality of condensed sheaf maps at a profinite test object and a continuous coefficient section. The formulas for chartComparisonAdjoint, lowerStarFactor.inv and continuousFunctionPushforward reduce it to precomposition by two scheme projections. Unfold pullbackComp.inv and use pullback.lift_fst and pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_hom_fst to identify these projections. Apply the scheme underlying continuous-map functor and reassociate continuous-map composition. Extensionality completes the adjunct equality, and injectivity of the Hom equivalence gives the original square.

proof_origin.place: Section 6.8, continuous coefficient framework; analytic matrix-chart reduction
proof_origin.note: The matrix argument is an agent reduction, not a matrix argument stated in Lemma 6.8.7. F1 proves this scheme-naturality subargument directly from existing categorical coherence and the explicit continuous-function constructions, with no additional hypotheses or residual statements.

lean.statement:
theorem continuousChart_scheme_naturality {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (O : Type) [TopologicalSpace O] [Ring O] [IsTopologicalRing O] :
    condensedPushforwardHom (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj O) f ≫
      (ProEtale.lowerStar Ab.{u + 1} f).map (chartComparison Y O) =
    chartComparison X O ≫ continuousFunctionPushforward f O
